name: Man Group PLC
blurb: Man Group PLC is a global active investment management firm headquartered in London, specializing in alternative strategies including quantitative and systematic investing, long-only, and private markets. As one of the world's largest publicly traded hedge fund managers, it manages over $150 billion in assets under management. The company's flagship AHL and Man Numeric divisions are leaders in systematic and quantitative investing.
recent: In the past 30 days, Man Group's stock (EMG.L) has traded near its 52-week high of 281.00 GBp, reflecting strong investor sentiment. The company reported solid full-year results for 2025, with net income rising and assets under management reaching record levels. Analysts have highlighted the firm's diversified revenue streams and robust performance fees as key drivers.
